description: Ghandhara Industries Limited is a Karachi-based vehicle assembler whose principal activity, as stated in its own filings, is the assembly, progressive manufacturing and sale of Isuzu trucks, buses and pick ups. Incorporated in 1963, its shares are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
